text: Who has been backing Silver Blaze, so that his price has shortened?
why: The Colonel says the odds have shortened from fifteen to one to three to one, and Holmes says somebody knows something, so the question naturally arises.

text: Who has been backing Silver Blaze, so that his price has shortened? — someone else who has heard that the horse is found
id: q.odds_who=someone else who has heard that the horse is found
why: The reader knows Holmes found the horse at Mapleton with Silas Brown, so others learning the horse is safe is a reasonable possibility. It reveals nothing new.
